project.description: Corporate website of ALFEC (Engineering, Procurement, Construction), Oran, Algeria. This model is the behavioral contract captured from the production site on 2026-09-26, before the redesign. The redesign may replace every implementation detail and the whole visual presentation, but must keep this behavior compatible unless a change is explicitly accepted as an evolution.

coreFeatures.description: Understand who ALFEC is and what it can build: sections, trades, sectors, commitments, photos, in French or English.
Start a project conversation with ALFEC: contact details and the enquiry form.
